versions.content: StaticSocketConnection for IP multicast reception of GeneralPurposePdus with category SD A UDP Socket is used for reception of SD messages using a local multicast address. One StaticSocketConnection shall be created for each EcuInstance that participates in the SD message exchange to define: • IP multicast reception of SD messages (OfferService, StopOfferService, Find- Service) by the EcuInstance The PduTriggering for the received GeneralPurposePdus that is defined in [TPS_SYST_02413] shall be assigned to the StaticSocketConnection via So- ConIPduIdentifier. The StaticSocketConnection shall be aggregated on the multicast SocketAddress over which the EcuInstance receives the SD messages.
